lines.text: Job says miners dig silver, gold, iron and copper from the earth, cutting shafts far from where people live.
Job says sapphires with flecks of gold lie in the rocks, on a path no falcon has seen and no lion has prowled.

wrong_details.wrong: no falcon has seen and no lion has prowled
wrong_details.true: no falcon's eye has seen it and no lion has ever prowled over it

lines.text: The miner overturns mountains and stops up streams to bring hidden things to light, but Job asks where wisdom can be found.
Wisdom is found in the land of the living, and the ocean depths say it is not in them.

wrong_details.wrong: Wisdom is found in the land of the living
wrong_details.true: Wisdom is not found in the land of the living

lines.text: God understands wisdom's way, having measured the waters, and He tells man that the fear of the Lord is wisdom.
